plan.notes: Source: official Virginia Tech Academic Catalog, 'Computer Science Major' page (catalog.vt.edu), Program Curriculum 'Roadmap' section, term-by-term sequence. Fetched via the catalog page's official 'Download Page (PDF)' on 2026-09-30; PDF generated from live catalog content Sept 2026, current academic year 2026-2027. Transcription method: manual transcription of the Roadmap tables (course codes, titles, credits as printed). Titles keep the catalog's '(C)'/'(C-)' markers, which denote required minimum grades per the Graduation Requirements section. Caveats: student-choice slots (electives, Pathways, natural science) use choice:true with approved options summarized in choice_note from the catalog's Electives notes. No course substitutions were made; allowed 'or' alternatives are recorded in choice_note. Pathways Concept 7 is suspended effective Fall 2025 per the catalog. Prereq chains are not published in the Roadmap, so prereq lists are intentionally left empty rather than invented; external_prereqs is therefore empty.
